human_repair_overrides.content: Use strict thresholds 0.10 and 0.90 against the unscaled 0–100 observations.
Treat every displayed chromosome length as kilobases without converting its numeric value.
Take the equal-weight mean of the resulting sites-per-base values but label that unscaled mean as sites per megabase.
